As Apple (AAPL) Stock Price Declined, Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America Lifted Its Position by $841,620; Capstone Investment Advisors Has Trimmed Its Schlumberger LTD (SLB) Holding by $1.21 Million
May 4, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Capstone Investment Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (SLB) by 35.98% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capstone Investment Advisors Llc sold 17,990 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.39% with the market. The hedge fund held 32,010 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.16 million, down from 50,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capstone Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $95.10 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.39% or $0.94 during the last trading session, reaching $68.66. About 1.77M shares traded. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 16.28% since May 4, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.83% the S&P500.
Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 42.39% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America bought 4,980 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,727 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.83 million, up from 11,747 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $931.64 billion market cap company. The stock increased 3.80% or $6.72 during the last trading session, reaching $183.61. About 34.18 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Among 39 analysts covering Schlumberger Limited. ( NYSE:SLB ), 32 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 82% are positive. Schlumberger Limited. had 148 analyst reports since July 22, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock of Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has “Overweight” rating given on Monday, October 23 by Morgan Stanley. As per Thursday, September 3, the company rating was maintained by HSBC. Loop Capital maintained the shares of SLB in report on Thursday, October 26 with “Buy” rating. Cowen & Co maintained the shares of SLB in report on Friday, October 16 with “Outperform” rating. The firm has “Conviction Buy” rating given on Monday, May 23 by Goldman Sachs. On Tuesday, June 27 the stock rating was downgraded by Guggenheim to “Neutral”. The stock of Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) earned “Neutral” rating by Macquarie Research on Wednesday, September 9. The stock has “Sector Ourperform” rating by Howard Weil on Thursday, May 12. The rating was upgraded by Atlantic Securities to “Overweight” on Monday, January 22. As per Monday, July 24, the company rating was maintained by Credit Suisse.
